text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Tonight, a star-studded lineup clashes to crown
a new Emperor of the Dirt in the Teio Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The competition is way too stacked this year, too!!
Who in the world is gonna win this...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's been on a real roll lately,
but maybe today's a bit too tough...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...It's like a tempest.
The spiritual veins here are thrown into utter disarray,
refusing to point in a single direction.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the same goes for wins and losses—
I guess that's just how deep the field is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Through this race, I too will see for myself.
When the right time will come...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(—Every single one of them has incredible spirit.
It's the grand finale of the first half of the year, so of course they do.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: She's completely calmed down... and turned into quite a formidable child, my goodness.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-Is that supposed to be a compliment...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is!
That's just how much Tarumae-chan right now is—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It means she's strong, simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like starting today,
it's going to be our real race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You saw right through everything,
didn't you, Acute-san?
How desperate and overwhelmed I was—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
And, please let me say just this right now."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In order to surpass Falco-san,
I am going to win this race today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That is why this is a showdown, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The sand of this Oi Racecourse... with the fire burning inside us!
